account_notes:
Lead source: PLG signup from indie developer; onboarded via quickstart.

Primary product interest: hosted API for chat widget in mobile game and nightly digest emails (summaries).
Tech stack: Node.js backend, Postgres, Vercel front-end. Wants minimal infra changes.

Key metrics (updated):
- Target p95 latency: <300ms ideal, <350ms acceptable for first paid rollout.
- Batch embedding throughput target: ~200 reqs/min (unchanged).
- Cost sensitivity remains high; now specifically asked for a hard monthly cap + alerting.

Model preference: open/quantized models if available; will try smaller 7B-style first. Not tied to Redwood models yet — "try cheap and scale".
Routing/fallbacks: wants automatic fallback to cheaper variant when budget hits threshold (still important). Added nuance: prefers quality-preserving fallback for chat, but ok with cheaper embeddings.

Streaming: previously a question; now tested streaming beta in staging and is positive on perceived latency/UX.
Latency observations: inconsistent p95 spikes remain during peak hours; median is acceptable. They care most about spikes during player surges.

Security/compliance: no enterprise SSO. Requirements: data retention controls, opt-out for user-data aggregation. Will need a simple deletion API (this became a must-have before they fully roll out chat to all players).

Quote from founder: "We need something that just works at 2am when our players flood chat — no complex ops please."

POC status: digest summaries now in production behind feature flag; chat remains in staged rollout until latency and budget cap are clearer.

Internal: This account likely converts if we provide (1) clear spend controls (budget cap / rate limits / alerts) and (2) a crisp deletion/retention story. Keep it self-serve friendly; avoid heavy enterprise motions.
open_questions:
1) What is the recommended implementation for deletion requests (single user, batch, and full account purge)? Do we support a deletion webhook confirmation or only polling?
2) Can we offer a budget cap mechanism (hard stop vs soft warn) for self-serve?
3) Any guidance on mitigating p95 spikes for bursty chat traffic (queueing vs concurrency limits, region selection)?
4) Confirm whether streaming endpoint is GA timeline and any breaking changes expected.
